messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets; improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling.
- Improve shard access with higher jumps and additional stepping platforms or moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, and respawn behavior to training wisps and included them in combat target updates.
- Made Escape toggle between paused and playing; added soft camera tracking toward a living lock-on target when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing.
- Added sky-zone cloud steps, lowered the nearby shard, and added cloud steps toward northern isles.
- Increased jump and double-jump velocity; added crystal-zone moving lifts and a ruins-zone moving platform with stepping stones.
- Ran `node --check` successfully on `js/Player.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js` before the final small platform-position adjustments.

## Aetherbound — Shards of Dawn

A self-contained Three.js third-person action adventure. Cross four connected
realms — Sunlit Meadow, Ancient Ruins, Crystal Caverns and Skybound Isles —
gather 32 dawn shards, and defeat the four wardens who seal the road to dawn.

### Play

Serve the repository root over HTTP and open the page:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3002
# then open http://localhost:3002
```

Three.js and the fonts load from CDNs, so an internet connection is required.

### Controls

| Action | Keyboard / mouse |
| --- | --- |
| Move | `W` `A` `S` `D` |
| Look | Mouse (click to capture) |
| Jump / double jump | `Space` |
| Dash | `Shift` |
| Attack combo | `J` / left click |
| Lock on | `Q` |
| Interact / travel | `E` |
| Pause | `Esc` |
| Mute | `M` |

Gamepad and touch controls are also supported.

### Progress

Each realm's warden guards the exit. Defeating a warden opens the gate or portal
to the next realm. Checkpoints restore health and set your respawn point; the
journey autosaves every few seconds and whenever progress changes.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets; improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling.
- Improve shard access with higher jumps and additional stepping platforms or moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Made Escape toggle pause and resume; added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing.
- Added sky-zone cloud steps, lowered a nearby shard, and added steps toward northern isles.
- Increased jump and double-jump velocity.
- Added crystal-zone moving lifts and a ruins-zone moving platform with stepping stones.
- JavaScript syntax checks pass for edited files; `git diff --check` reports no whitespace errors.
- Respawned from the sky-zone game-over screen; game is playable again in the sky zone at `[0, 44, -76.55]` with 5 HP.

### Active
- Verify shard and platform reachability across meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky, especially shards reached via moving platforms.
- Re-run gameplay checks after the latest edits.
- Save and inspect a fresh compliant JPEG screenshot; viewport is 1280×760.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test shard and platform reachability across all zones, including crystal moving-platform routes.
2. Re-run browser gameplay checks after the latest edits.
3. Save and inspect a fresh JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize the finished work and note assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `js/main.js`: game flow, training wisps, pause, lock-on camera, and interactions.
- `js/Player.js`: movement, jump, combat, and damage behavior.
- `js/World.js`: zone assembly and world objects.
- `js/world/Objects.js`: moving platforms, portals, checkpoints, and shards.
- `js/world/meadow.js`: meadow shards and platforms.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: ruins-zone platforms and shards.
- `js/world/crystal.js`: crystal-zone lifts, platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/sky.js`: sky-zone islands, cloud steps, and shards.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.
- `screenshots/`: visual test images.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push was performed. Modified files: `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`.
- Browser URL is `http://localhost:3002/`; current game state is playing in sky zone after respawn.
- Game exposes `window.__aether`; runtime confirms 8 shards in each zone.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets; improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling.
- Improve shard access with higher jumps and additional stepping platforms or moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Made Escape toggle pause and resume; added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing.
- Added sky-zone cloud steps, lowered a nearby shard, and added steps toward northern isles.
- Increased jump and double-jump velocity.
- Added crystal-zone moving lifts and a ruins-zone moving platform with stepping stones.
- Confirmed the world contains 32 shards, moving platforms in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky, and unlocked zone-return/forward portals.
- `git diff --check` passed; `package.json` is absent.

### Active
- Verify shard and platform reachability across meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky, especially routes involving moving platforms.
- Re-run gameplay checks after the latest edits.
- Save and inspect a fresh compliant JPEG screenshot; viewport should be no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test shard and platform reachability across all zones, including crystal moving-platform routes.
2. Re-run browser gameplay checks after the latest edits.
3. Save and inspect a fresh JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize the finished work and note assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `js/main.js`: game flow, training wisps, pause, lock-on camera, and interactions.
- `js/Player.js`: movement, jump, combat, and damage behavior.
- `js/World.js`: zone assembly and world objects.
- `js/world/Objects.js`: moving platforms, portals, checkpoints, and shards.
- `js/world/meadow.js`: meadow shards and platforms.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: ruins-zone platforms and shards.
- `js/world/crystal.js`: crystal-zone lifts, platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/sky.js`: sky-zone islands, cloud steps, and shards.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.
- `screenshots/`: visual test images.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push was performed. Modified files: `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`.
- Browser URL is `http://localhost:3002/`; game is playing in sky zone near `[0.256, 44, -84.954]` with 5 HP; viewport is 1280×760.
- `window.__aether.world.gems` has 8 shards per zone; `window.__aether.world.movingPlatforms` exposes each moving platform’s zone, base, axis, amplitude, and speed.
- Portal data showed the forward and return portals unlocked. Actual shard/platform reachability and post-edit gameplay remain unverified.

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog

  go-forward                  go forward to the next page

Storage:

  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)

  localstorage-list           list all localstorage key-value pairs

  localstorage-delete <key>   delete a localstorage item
  localstorage-clear          clear all localstorage
  sessionstorage-list         list all sessionstorage key-value pairs
  sessionstorage-get <key>    get a sessionstorage item by key
  sessionstorage-set <key> <value> set a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-delete <key> delete a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-clear        clear all sessionstorage

Network:
  requests                    list all network requests since loading the page. each request is numbered for use with the `request` command.
  request <index>             show full details (headers, body, response) of a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-headers <index>     print only the request headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-body <index>        print only the request body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-headers <index>    print only the response headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-body <index>       print the response body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command. textual bodies are inlined; binary bodies are saved to a file and the path is printed.
  route <pattern>             mock network requests matching a url pattern
  route-list                  list all active network routes
  unroute [pattern]           remove routes matching a pattern (or all routes)
  network-state-set <state>   set the browser network state to online or offline

DevTools:
  console [min-level]         list console messages
  run-code [code]             run playwright code snippet
  recording-start             start recording user actions
  recording-stop              stop recording user actions and print them as playwright code
  tracing-start               start trace recording
  tracing-stop                stop trace recording
  video-start [filename]      start video recording
  video-stop                  stop video recording
  video-chapter <title>       add a chapter marker to the video recording
  video-show-actions          annotate subsequent cli/mcp actions on the page with a callout that names the action and highlights the target element
  video-hide-actions          stop annotating actions performed on the page
  show                        show playwright dashboard
  pause-at <location>         run the test up to a specific location and pause there
  resume                      resume the test execution
  step-over                   step over the next call in the test
  generate-locator <target>   generate a playwright locator for the given element
  highlight [target]          show (or with --hide, remove) a highlight overlay for an element; `--hide` without a target hides all page highlights.

Install:
  install                     initialize workspace
  install-browser [browser]   install browser

Browser sessions:
  list                        list browser sessions
  close-all                   close all browser sessions
  kill-all                    forcefully kill all browser sessions (for stale/zombie processes)

Global options:
  --help [command]            print help
  --json                      output response as JSON
  --raw                       output only the result value, without status and code

21: 
22: A self-contained Three.js third-person action adventure. Cross four connected

24: gather 32 dawn shards, and defeat the four wardens who seal the road to dawn.

40: | --- | --- |

  goto <url>                  navigate to a url

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets; improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling.
- Improve shard access with higher jumps and additional stepping platforms or moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing and improved routes with cloud steps, lowered shards, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.

- (none)

- `js/world/sky.js`: sky cloud steps and shards.

- `screenshots/final.jpg`: latest captured 1280×760 JPEG.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets; improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling.
- Improve shard access with higher jumps and additional stepping platforms or moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing and improved routes with cloud steps, lowered shards, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.
- Removed the duplicate Escape keydown handler; verified Escape toggles playing → paused → playing with 500ms between presses.
- Confirmed the world has 32 shards and moving platforms in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky.
- Regenerated `screenshots/final.jpg` at 1280×760 and inspected the latest screenshot.
- Confirmed `http://localhost:3002/` responds with HTTP 200; `git diff --check` passes.

### Active
- Test shard and platform route reachability across meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky, especially crystal moving-platform routes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test shard and platform route reachability across all four zones, prioritizing the crystal moving-platform routes.
2. Run `git diff --check` after any further edits.

## Relevant Files
- `js/world/crystal.js`: Crystal lifts, platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/meadow.js`: Meadow platforms and shards.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: Ruins platforms and shards.
- `js/world/sky.js`: Sky cloud steps and shards.
- `js/world/Objects.js`: Moving-platform behavior.
- `js/Player.js`: Movement and jump behavior.
- `js/main.js`: Game flow, training wisps, pause handling, and lock-on camera.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.
- `screenshots/final.jpg`: Latest captured 1280×760 JPEG.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`; no commit or push was performed.
- Crystal moving lifts and high shard routes were inspected, but gameplay reachability has not been verified.
- Browser automation can access the running game through `window.__aether`; `startGame(fresh)` and `enterZone(zone, { spawn })` are available for gameplay checks.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets; improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling.
- Improve shard access with higher jumps and additional stepping platforms or moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing and improved routes with cloud steps, lowered shards, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.
- Removed the duplicate Escape keydown handler; verified Escape toggles playing → paused → playing with 500ms between presses.
- Confirmed the world has 32 shards and moving platforms in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky.
- Regenerated `screenshots/final.jpg` at 1280×760 and inspected the latest screenshot.
- Confirmed `http://localhost:3002/` responds with HTTP 200; `git diff --check` passes.
- Confirmed the browser game is in `playing` state and can enter the crystal zone.
- Adjusted crystal lift low positions to bring them within jumping distance of the cavern floor.
- Reloaded the browser in a fresh session and confirmed it now loads the updated crystal lift configuration.

### Active
- Validate boarding and being carried by a crystal lift; latest simulated jump did not register a landing on the lift.
- Continue shard and platform route checks in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect crystal lift landing behavior and correct the route or test setup if needed; verify the player can board and ride a lift.
2. Continue route checks in all four zones; run `git diff --check` after edits.

## Relevant Files
- `js/world/crystal.js`: Crystal lifts, platforms, and shards; lift low points were recently changed and need gameplay verification.
- `js/world/Objects.js`: Moving-platform behavior and player-carrying delta.
- `js/Player.js`: Jumping, movement, and platform collision behavior.
- `js/world/meadow.js`: Meadow platforms and shards.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: Ruins platforms and shards.
- `js/world/sky.js`: Sky cloud steps and shards.
- `js/main.js`: Game flow, training wisps, pause handling, and lock-on camera.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.
- `screenshots/final.jpg`: Latest captured 1280×760 JPEG.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`; no commit or push was performed.
- Browser gameplay checks are available through `window.__aether`; `enterZone(zone, { spawn })` can place the player for testing.
- Freshly reopened browser confirmed crystal lift bases/amplitudes changed, including the lift at `[-33, -18.9, -152]` with amplitude `4.55`; one simulated attempt to board it did not set `standingOn` to that lift.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets; improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling.
- Improve shard access with higher jumps and additional stepping platforms or moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing and improved routes with cloud steps, lowered shards, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.
- Removed the duplicate Escape keydown handler; verified Escape toggles playing → paused → playing with 500ms between presses.
- Confirmed the world has 32 shards and moving platforms in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky.
- Regenerated and inspected `screenshots/final.jpg` at 1280×760; confirmed `http://localhost:3002/` responds with HTTP 200 and `git diff --check` passes.
- Confirmed the crystal zone loads updated lifts; boarded the lift at `[-33, -18.9, -152]` and rode it to its high point.
- Identified all 32 shard positions across meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky.

### Active
- Continue shard and platform route checks in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; adjust gameplay only if a route proves inaccessible.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue route checks across all four zones; adjust gameplay only if a route proves inaccessible.
2. Run `git diff --check` and regenerate/inspect the latest screenshot if visual changes are made.

## Relevant Files
- `js/world/crystal.js`: Crystal lifts, platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/Objects.js`: Moving-platform movement and player-carrying delta.
- `js/Player.js`: Jumping, movement, and platform collision behavior.
- `js/world/meadow.js`: Meadow platforms and shards.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: Ruins platforms and shards.
- `js/world/sky.js`: Sky cloud steps and shards.
- `js/main.js`: Game flow, training wisps, pause handling, and lock-on camera.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.
- `screenshots/final.jpg`: Latest captured 1280×760 JPEG.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`; no commit or push was performed.
- Browser gameplay checks are available through `window.__aether`; `enterZone(zone, { spawn })` can place the player for testing.
- For manual simulation through `window.__aether`, set `g.state = "playing"` and `g.input.enabled = true`; otherwise player updates can early-return.
- `window.__aetherInput` exposes input state and `window.__THREE` exposes Three.js.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets; improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling.
- Improve shard access with higher jumps and additional stepping platforms or moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing and improved routes with cloud steps, lowered shards, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.
- Removed the duplicate Escape keydown handler; verified Escape toggles playing → paused → playing with 500ms between presses.
- Confirmed the world has 32 shards and moving platforms in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky.

- Confirmed the crystal zone loads updated lifts; boarded the lift at `[-33, -18.9, -152]` and rode it to its high point.
- Identified all 32 shard positions across meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky.
- Reviewed the meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky shard and platform layouts; no code changes were made during this review.

### Active
- Continue shard and platform route checks in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; adjust gameplay only if a route proves inaccessible.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue route checks across all four zones; adjust gameplay only if a route proves inaccessible.
2. Run `git diff --check` and regenerate/inspect the latest screenshot if visual changes are made.

## Relevant Files
- `js/world/crystal.js`: Crystal lifts, platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/Objects.js`: Moving-platform movement and player-carrying delta.
- `js/Player.js`: Jumping, movement, and platform collision behavior.
- `js/world/meadow.js`: Meadow platforms and shards.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: Ruins platforms and shards.
- `js/world/sky.js`: Sky cloud steps and shards.
- `js/main.js`: Game flow, training wisps, pause handling, and lock-on camera.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.
- `screenshots/final.jpg`: Latest captured 1280×760 JPEG.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`; no commit or push was performed.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets; improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling.
- Improve shard access with higher jumps and additional stepping platforms or moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing and improved routes with cloud steps, lowered shards, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.
- Removed the duplicate Escape keydown handler; verified Escape toggles playing → paused → playing with 500ms between presses.
- Confirmed 32 shards and moving platforms in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; inspected route layouts across zones.
- Confirmed crystal lifts load and rode one lift to its high point.
- Ran `git diff --check`; latest screenshot was `screenshots/final.jpg` at 1280×760, and `http://localhost:3002/` responded with HTTP 200.

### Active
- Validate shard and platform route accessibility through gameplay in all four zones; adjust gameplay only if a route proves inaccessible.
- Initial crystal-zone forward movement test from `[0, -23.95, -146]` showed the player remained near spawn and collected no shards; investigate before treating the crystal route as validated.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue gameplay route checks in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; determine whether the crystal test was a test-input/setup issue or an actual access problem.
2. Adjust gameplay only if a route proves inaccessible.
3. Run `git diff --check` and regenerate/inspect the latest screenshot if visual changes are made.

## Relevant Files
- `js/world/crystal.js`: Crystal lifts, platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/Objects.js`: Moving-platform movement and player-carrying delta.
- `js/Player.js`: Jumping, movement, and platform collision behavior.
- `js/world/meadow.js`: Meadow platforms and shards.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: Ruins platforms and shards.
- `js/world/sky.js`: Sky cloud steps and shards.
- `js/main.js`: Game flow, training wisps, pause handling, zone entry, shard collection, and lock-on camera.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.
- `screenshots/final.jpg`: Latest captured 1280×760 JPEG.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`; no commit or push was performed.

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page

  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref

Navigation:

  response-headers <index>    print only the response headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.

DevTools:

  recording-stop              stop recording user actions and print them as playwright code

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets; improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling.
- Improve shard access with higher jumps and additional stepping platforms or moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing and improved routes with cloud steps, lowered shards, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.
- Removed the duplicate Escape keydown handler; previously verified Escape toggles playing → paused → playing.
- Confirmed 32 shards and moving platforms in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; inspected route layouts across zones.
- Diagnosed the apparent browser animation-frame stall as resolved: crystal-zone movement progressed under browser input from z≈-147 to z≈-196 with the player grounded.
- Simulated crystal-zone forward movement directly through `Player.update`; it moved freely to z≈-162 with no overlapping collider obstruction.
- Ran `git diff --check`; latest screenshot was `screenshots/final.jpg` at 1280×760, and `http://localhost:3002/` responded with HTTP 200.

### Active
- Validate shard and platform route accessibility through gameplay in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; adjust geometry only if a route proves inaccessible.
- Continue real-input checks in crystal and other zones; existing check confirmed movement, but did not yet validate the shard/platform routes themselves.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue gameplay route checks in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; adjust geometry only if a route proves inaccessible.
2. Run `git diff --check` and regenerate/inspect the latest screenshot if visual changes are made.

## Relevant Files
- `js/Player.js`: Player movement, jumping, and collision resolution.
- `js/main.js`: Game loop, zone entry, shard collection, and lock-on camera.
- `js/world/crystal.js`: Crystal arrival arch, lifts, platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/meadow.js`: Meadow routes, stepping platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: Ruins routes, lifts, and shards.
- `js/world/sky.js`: Sky routes, cloud steps, and shards.
- `js/world/Props.js`: Arch geometry and collider creation.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.
- `screenshots/final.jpg`: Latest captured 1280×760 JPEG.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`; no commit or push was performed.
- Crystal spawn reset can be tested with `g.enterZone("crystal", {spawn: new window.__THREE.Vector3(0, -23.95, -146), announce: false, instant: true})`.
- For manual simulation through `window.__aether`, set `g.state = "playing"` and `g.input.enabled = true`; `window.__aetherInput` exposes input state and `window.__THREE` exposes Three.js.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets; improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling.
- Improve shard access with higher jumps and additional stepping platforms or moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing and improved routes with cloud steps, lowered shards, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.
- Removed the duplicate Escape keydown handler; previously verified Escape toggles playing → paused → playing.
- Confirmed 32 shards and moving platforms in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; inspected route layouts across zones.
- Confirmed crystal-zone movement progresses under browser input with the player grounded; direct `Player.update` simulation also moved without collider obstruction.
- Latest recorded checks: `git diff --check` passed, `http://localhost:3002/` returned HTTP 200, and `screenshots/final.jpg` was 1280×760.

### Active
- Validate shard and platform route accessibility through gameplay in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; adjust geometry only if a route proves inaccessible.
- Continue real-input checks. The browser was set to meadow and keyboard `w` was confirmed as active input, but the latest movement attempt did not establish route accessibility.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue real gameplay route checks in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; adjust geometry only if a route proves inaccessible.
2. Run `git diff --check` and regenerate/inspect the latest screenshot if visual changes are made.

## Relevant Files
- `js/Player.js`: Player movement, jumping, and collision resolution.
- `js/main.js`: Game loop, zone entry, shard collection, and lock-on camera.
- `js/world/crystal.js`: Crystal arrival arch, lifts, platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/meadow.js`: Meadow routes, stepping platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: Ruins routes, lifts, and shards.
- `js/world/sky.js`: Sky routes, cloud steps, and shards.
- `js/world/Props.js`: Arch geometry and collider creation.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.
- `screenshots/final.jpg`: Latest captured 1280×760 JPEG.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`; no commit or push was performed.
- Crystal spawn reset can be tested with `g.enterZone("crystal", {spawn: new window.__THREE.Vector3(0, -23.95, -146), announce: false, instant: true})`.
- For manual simulation through `window.__aether`, set `g.state = "playing"` and `g.input.enabled = true`; `window.__aetherInput` exposes input state and `window.__THREE` exposes Three.js.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets, improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling, and make shard routes more accessible with higher jumps, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing and improved routes with cloud steps, lowered shards, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.
- Removed the duplicate Escape keydown handler; previously verified Escape toggles playing → paused → playing.
- Confirmed 32 shards and moving platforms in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; inspected route layouts across zones.
- Confirmed crystal-zone movement progresses under browser input with the player grounded; direct `Player.update` simulation also moved without collider obstruction.
- Verified gameplay movement in meadow, reaching approximately `z=-19.8` while grounded.
- Latest `git diff --check` passed; `http://localhost:3002/` returned HTTP 200; `screenshots/final.jpg` was recorded at 1280×760.

### Active
- Validate shard and platform route accessibility through gameplay in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; adjust geometry only if a route proves inaccessible.
- Ruins movement is still inconclusive: from the threshold near `[0, 2.4, -66]`, browser input advanced to around `z=-70` with slight lateral drift; the player remained grounded on the plateau collider.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue real gameplay route checks in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; inspect movement/input and adjust geometry only if a route proves inaccessible.
2. Run `git diff --check` and regenerate/inspect the latest screenshot if visual changes are made.

## Relevant Files
- `js/Player.js`: Player movement, jumping, and collision resolution.
- `js/main.js`: Game loop, zone entry, shard collection, and lock-on camera.
- `js/world/crystal.js`: Crystal arrival arch, lifts, platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/meadow.js`: Meadow routes, stepping platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: Ruins routes, lifts, and shards.
- `js/world/sky.js`: Sky routes, cloud steps, and shards.
- `js/world/Props.js`: Arch geometry and collider creation.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.
- `screenshots/final.jpg`: Latest recorded 1280×760 JPEG.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`; no commit or push was performed.
- Crystal spawn reset can be tested with `g.enterZone("crystal", {spawn: new window.__THREE.Vector3(0, -23.95, -146), announce: false, instant: true})`.
- For manual simulation through `window.__aether`, set `g.state = "playing"` and `g.input.enabled = true`; `window.__aetherInput` exposes input state and `window.__THREE` exposes Three.js.
- The latest ruins diagnostic showed the player grounded on the plateau collider at `[0.99, 2.4, -69.95]`; the arch at `z=-74` has a central opening.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets, improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling, and make shard routes more accessible with higher jumps, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing and improved routes with cloud steps, lowered shards, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.
- Removed the duplicate Escape keydown handler; previously verified Escape toggles playing → paused → playing.
- Confirmed 32 shards and moving platforms in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; inspected route layouts across zones.
- Direct ruins simulation now passes the portal steps and reaches the crystal-zone ground after updating step-up support detection in `js/Player.js`.
- `git diff --check` passed after prior edits.

### Active
- Continue real gameplay route checks in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky, including confirming portal transitions and collectible/boss progression.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run gameplay route checks across all four zones, verifying portals and progression in-game.
2. Run `git diff --check`; if visual changes are made, capture and inspect only the latest screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `js/Player.js`: Movement, collision resolution, and the recent grounded-support inference for stepping up.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: Ruins steps, portal dais, shard ledge, and route geometry.
- `js/main.js`: Game loop, zone entry, shard collection, and lock-on camera.
- `js/World.js`: World assembly, platform creation, and collider storage.
- `js/world/Props.js`: Arch geometry and collider creation.
- `js/world/crystal.js`: Crystal arrival arch, lifts, platforms, and shards.
- `js/world/meadow.js`: Meadow routes and stepping platforms.
- `js/world/sky.js`: Sky routes and cloud steps.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`; no commit or push was performed.
- Local site URL: `http://localhost:3002/`.
- Reloading at the menu leaves `window.__aether` without an initialized player; start a journey with `#btn-new` before direct simulation.
- `window.__aether` and `window.__THREE` expose game state and Three.js in the browser. Direct simulation uses `player.update(dt, input, 0, g.lockTarget)` with an input stub returning `{x:0,y:1,len:1}` for movement.
- Ruins movement from `[0, 2.45, -66]` reaches the portal dais steps and continues off the far edge into the crystal-zone ground; prior obstruction near `z=-116.579` is resolved.

Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets, improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling, and make shard routes more accessible with higher jumps, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps.
- Added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing and improved routes with cloud steps, lowered shards, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.
- Removed the duplicate Escape keydown handler; previously verified Escape toggles playing → paused → playing.
- Confirmed 32 shards and moving platforms in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; inspected route layouts across zones.
- Fixed ruins step-up support detection in `js/Player.js`; simulation traverses the portal dais to the crystal-zone ground.
- Verified progression lock states and all six zone transitions via `travelToZone()` with correct destination zones and spawn positions.
- Lowered the crystal sky-portal dais to a 0.25-unit step from the cavern floor in `js/world/crystal.js`; straight-line movement from the crystal arrival now reaches the dais and passes the portal proximity radius.
- Confirmed the crystal return route from `[0,-23.95,-196]` reaches within 1.6 units of the ruins portal at `z=-139`.
- `git diff --check` passed before the latest crystal dais edit.

### Active
- Validate portal interaction and route access in live gameplay, then continue checks for combat, shard collection, and boss progression across zones.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Start a fresh game or otherwise enter active gameplay, then test physical crystal portal interactions to sky and ruins; confirm travel and spawn behavior.
2. Continue gameplay checks for combat, shard collection, boss progression, and portal access across all zones.
3. Run `git diff --check`; if visual changes are made, capture and inspect only the latest screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `js/world/crystal.js`: Crystal floor, portal dais, platforms, lifts, hazards, and shards.
- `js/Player.js`: Movement, collision resolution, and grounded-support inference.
- `js/main.js`: Zone entry, portal travel, progression gates, shard collection, and lock-on camera.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: Ruins route, portal dais, shards, and platforms.
- `js/world/sky.js`: Sky route and portals.
- `js/World.js`: World assembly, platform creation, and collider storage.
- `js/world/Props.js`: Arch geometry and collider creation.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`; no commit or push was performed.
- Local site URL: `http://localhost:3002/`; reload opens the menu. Browser game state is exposed as `window.__aether`, Three.js as `window.__THREE`.
- `game.startGame(true)` starts a fresh journey; `game.enterZone()` can set a test zone and spawn, but alone does not switch the game out of the menu state.
- The crystal sky route previously stopped at `z=-196.28` because the dais top was too high; after lowering it, movement reached `z=-202.11`, grounded, with full HP. The return route simulation reached `z=-137.42`, near the ruins portal.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Aetherbound project as a complete, playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing Aetherbound project as the game to finish.
- Add training wisps as combat targets, improve lock-on camera behavior and Escape pause toggling, and make shard routes more accessible with higher jumps, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added HP, damage handling, respawn behavior, and combat targeting for training wisps; verified a wisp could be hit.
- Added soft camera tracking toward living lock-on targets when the player is not manually moving the camera.
- Adjusted mobile menu title sizing and improved routes with cloud steps, lowered shards, stepping platforms, and moving lifts.
- Removed the duplicate Escape keydown handler; previously verified Escape toggles playing → paused → playing.
- Confirmed 32 shards and moving platforms in meadow, ruins, crystal, and sky; inspected route layouts across zones.
- Fixed ruins step-up support detection in `js/Player.js`; simulation traverses the portal dais to crystal-zone ground.
- Lowered the crystal sky-portal dais to a 0.25-unit step in `js/world/crystal.js`; route simulation reaches the dais grounded with full HP.
- Verified fresh-game shard collection and wisp combat; later confirmed shard collection in all four zones.
- Verified all six zone transitions and portal return routes; transitions completed with input restored.
- Defeated all four bosses through direct combat registration, verified progression gates/portals unlock, and confirmed the victory screen appears after its delay.
- `git diff --check` passes.

### Active
- Continue live gameplay checks for boss combat and progression; a recent synthetic keyboard test did not damage the boss, so normal player-driven boss attacks remain to be verified.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Verify boss combat through normal gameplay input and progression across zones.
2. Run `git diff --check` after any changes; for visual changes, capture and inspect only the latest screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `js/main.js`: Zone entry/travel, progression gates, shard collection, combat targeting, and lock-on camera.
- `js/Player.js`: Movement, collision resolution, and grounded-support inference.
- `js/world/crystal.js`: Crystal route, portal dais, platforms, lifts, hazards, and shards.
- `js/world/ruins.js`: Ruins route, portal dais, shards, and platforms.
- `js/world/sky.js`: Sky route and portals.
- `index.html`: UI and responsive menu styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `js/Player.js`, `js/main.js`, `js/world/crystal.js`, `js/world/ruins.js`, and `js/world/sky.js`; no commit or push was performed.
- Local site URL: `http://localhost:3002/`; reload opens the menu. Browser game state is exposed as `window.__aether`, Three.js as `window.__THREE`.
- `game.startGame(true)` starts a fresh journey; `game.enterZone()` can set a test zone but does not itself switch from menu to active gameplay.
- A synthetic `KeyJ` boss-combat test left the boss HP unchanged and attack incomplete; treat normal live boss combat as unverified.
